subject: ZenWell — Subprocessor roster, SOC2 status, and next steps
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@zenwell.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Dec 2028 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: ZenWell — Subprocessor roster, SOC2 status, and next steps

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the security/compliance items that came up:  

• SOC 2: Redwood is in-scope for SOC 2 Type II; attached is a one-page coverage summary (SOC2-coverage-summary.pdf). We can provide the full report under NDA — please confirm your preferred intake path.

• Data types / HIPAA: From our conversation you indicated ZenWell will likely send identifiers + clinical notes in the pilot. That flags HIPAA considerations. Can you confirm whether PHI will be included in the pilot dataset?

• Subprocessors: Attached is our current subprocessor roster (redwood_subprocessors_v1.xlsx) — includes cloud providers and managed services. Action: please mark any subprocessors you’d like us to justify or exclude.

• Data flow / retention: I attached a simple data-flow diagram (initial-data-flow.svg) — Monica will follow up with retention and deletion timelines per tenant.

Next steps we propose:  
1) ZenWell to confirm PHI/no-PHI and any high-risk subprocessors (by EOD Thu PST).
2) Redwood to share SOC 2 intake details and point of contact for secure transfer of the full report.
3) Redwood to complete vendor questionnaire link we shared on the call; Monica will ping with the link and a short deadline.
4) Schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to close on evidence and any contractual wording (I suggested Wed or Thu afternoon).

If that lines up, we’ll proceed and Monica will circulate the questionnaire link + a tracked subprocessor sheet for your annotations.

Thanks — Mark

—
Markus Klein
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@zenwell.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: David Cole <david.cole@zenwell.com>, security@zenwell.com
Date: Tue, 5 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ZenWell — Subprocessor roster, SOC2 status, and next steps

Thanks, Markus — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side:  

• PHI: Yes, the pilot will include limited PHI (patient identifiers, timestamps, and clinician notes). HIPAA coverage is required; please confirm whether Redwood has a Business Associate Agreement template or if you prefer we start from our form.

• Subprocessors: We’ll review the roster but priority items for us are any service that processes unredacted notes and any analytics vendors that may see model outputs. We’ll flag those on the sheet.

• SOC 2: We would like the full Type II report under NDA. Security team asked if your SOC 2 covers system backups, key management (KMS), and encryption-at-rest for customer data — please call that out in the summary or point us to the control mapping.

• Questionnaire: Please send the vendor security questionnaire link and the expected turnaround; our security PM (cc’d to security@zenwell.com) will own the intake.

Happy to meet next Wed 12–3pm PT or Thu 10–12pm PT.

Elena

Date: Tue, 5 Dec 2028 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ZenWell — Subprocessor roster, SOC2 status, and next steps

Hi Elena — Monica here from the security/compliance intake team. Following up with the items we discussed and the questionnaire link:  

1) Questionnaire: https://forms.gle/zenwell-security-qa — expects ~20–25 minutes. If you prefer a spreadsheet version for bulk answers, I can send that. Target turnaround we usually set is 5 business days; if you need more time let us know.

2) Subprocessor sheet: I attached an updated copy of the roster (redwood_subprocessors_v1.xlsx) with three columns we’d like you to annotate: 
   - Does this processor see plaintext customer content? (Yes/No)
   - Requested justification/exclude? (free text)
   - Comments (for contract or technical controls)

3) SOC 2 specifics: Quick answers inline — backups are in-scope and managed by our cloud provider with customer-isolated storage; KMS is customer-dedicated keys in our Dedicated offering and multi-tenant managed KMS for hosted customers (we’ll call out exact key boundary in the full mapping). I’ll escalate for a control-to-control mapping and send that to security@zenwell.com under NDA.

4) HIPAA / BAA: We have a standard BAA we can share. If you prefer to start from your template, we can review redlines.

I’ll attach the subprocessor sheet in the Drive link and can also export to XLSX if that helps procurement. Proposed follow-up: Wed 6 Dec at 2pm PT (30m) — Markus, does that work for you?

Thanks — Monica

--
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance Programs, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Thanks team — quick operational notes from procurement/PS side:  

• Meeting: Wed 6 Dec 2pm PT is fine for the 30m sync — I’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda focused on evidence handoff and the BAA path.

• Evidence intake: Best route for the SOC 2 report is our secure intake portal (I’ll include a one-time upload token in the invite). If ZenWell needs the report sooner, we can set up an encrypted SFTP transfer.

• Timeline: for pilots involving PHI we recommend a 2–3 week security intake window (questionnaire + evidence + BAA) before go-live. I’ve recorded HS-8421 in HubSpot and added a procurement task for ZenWell intake.

• Links: HubSpot: HS-8421 (internal). Vendor questionnaire: https://forms.gle/zenwell-security-qa. Drive with attachments: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example

Looking forward to knocking this out Wednesday.

Best,
